summary: Extensions measure the consumer burden and allow controlled evolution without exposing the implementation graph.

items.text: Commit a generated public-surface report and set a review budget for new exports, parameters, error variants, and required call-order steps.
Use consumer-driven contract tests that exercise real tasks, including invalid inputs and recovery, so narrowing does not silently remove needed affordances.
Provide a stable task-level facade plus an explicitly experimental advanced interface with separate compatibility guarantees and telemetry.
Align each feature folder with one public entry point and enforce that cross-feature imports cannot reach its implementation files.
